title: AlphaCert: An Open-Source Toolkit for Quality-Control, pLDDT/PAE Assessment, and Stereochemical Certification of Predicted Protein Structures
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, pLDDT confidence categorization, 2D Predicted Aligned Error (PAE) matrix analysis, stereochemical clash detection, Ramachandran dihedral distributions, and downstream application certification (Docking-Ready, MD-Ready, Complex-Interface-Valid) for structures predicted by AlphaFold2, AlphaFold-Multimer, AlphaFold3, ColabFold, and ESMFold.
